Reading this on a computer?

Point the phone's camera here. The link opens in CruiseMesh on the phone.

App installed but nothing happened?

Open CruiseMesh, go to Settings → Shore Pass (called Cruise Pass on older app versions), choose Paste card and paste the setup card above, then choose Review, then Test and use.

Keep it private
